diagnostic_help:
usage: tool.py diagnostic [-h] [--offset OFFSET] [--limit LIMIT]
                          request_id module

positional arguments:
  request_id       request_id from check diagnostics_metadata
  module           module from check diagnostics_metadata

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --offset OFFSET  byte offset; follow next_offset until eof
  --limit LIMIT    requested bytes, 1 through 1048576
